description: Altri temi - Piani - PRPP Lotta incendi boschivi-2010 - Danno potenziale - Cartografie is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sardegnasira.it. La cartografia del Danno potenziale fa parte del Piano Regionale di Previsione Prevenzione e Lotta agl incendi boschivi per l'anno 2010 (PRPP), approvato con Delibera n. 20/16 del 19 magggio 2010. Il piano è stato redatto in conformità a quanto sancito dalla legge quadro nazionale in materia di incendi boschivi (legge n. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include Land cover, n.d.. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2020-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
